text:
kevin: deploybot preflight flagged regressions on summarizer-service canary (v2.4.0). need decision: pin, rollback, or proceed with mitigations?

deploybot: preflight summary -> prompt-suite delta: ROUGE -3.8%, hallucination rate +2.1%, length mean -15%. failing slice: legal/long-form (see https://ci/reports/1765001234). gate threshold = 2% core-metric delta.

sophie: I sampled top 50 failures. majority are hallucinations and truncated endings. repro locally with seed set. severity: medium.

ajay: looked at model diff — changed length_penalty and sampling temp in optimizer PR #4321. reverting length_penalty brings length back but not full halluc fix. possible quick patch: revert length_penalty and re-run preflight. estimate 25–35m to test + rerun.

olivia: product note: release window closes in 1h. policy: if core prompts degrade >3% we should not promote. current delta is 3.8% on ROUGE. leaning to block unless hotfix lands.

luis: if we rollback/pin, what's impact to infra? no downtime for pin. rollback requires db migration? (I don't think so) need the rollback command and ETA.

kevin: options: 1) pin to v2.3.0 for this window (non-disruptive). 2) attempt ajay's hotfix + rerun preflight, hold canary traffic until eval passes. 3) rollback to v2.3.0 (if hotfix fails or we exceed gate).

kevin: proposal: attempt hotfix + conditional proceed: hold canary traffic to 10%, enforce immediate preflight re-run, require core-metric delta <= 2% to expand. if hotfix not green by +45m, pin.

olivia: @kevin approved — product approves an attempt with strict rollback condition.

ajay: starting hotfix now, will push small revert PR and run internal eval. ping me for logs.

maria (evalbot): scheduled rerun of prompt-suite in 12m. will post summary here.

luis: please post rollback commands just in case.

kevin: rollback/pin commands (for on-call):
```bash
# pin model version for this release window
redwoodctl models set-default summarizer-service v2.3.0 --scope=release-window

# rollback (server-side immediate switch)
redwoodctl deploy rollback summarizer-service --to-version v2.3.0 --force
```

ajay: PR merged, starting canary with 0% traffic while eval runs. will open to 10% only if preflight green.

deploybot: canary deployment paused -> holding traffic at 0% pending preflight. preflight job id: pf-1765001234-2.

maria (evalbot): preflight first pass: ROUGE delta -1.4%, hallucination +0.8%, length mean -3%. overall core-metric now within 2% threshold. detailed report: https://ci/reports/1765001234/pf-2

sophie: quick manual spot-check of 20 items looks much better. hallucination cases reduced.

olivia: product approves proceeding to 10% canary under monitoring. Add regression alert to paging if metric crosses 2.5% in next 2 hours.

luis: adding alert -> pager on duty if core-metric > 2.5% sustained 5m.

kevin: executing plan: canary -> 10% traffic, strict eval gate hourly for 2 hours, rollback to v2.3.0 if threshold exceeded or if any safety regression flagged. release notes: note the hotfix and monitoring.

deploybot: canary traffic set to 10%. monitoring hooks enabled. will post hourly preflight summaries.

ajay: thanks everyone. I'll keep an eye on eval runs and push follow-ups if we see drift.

kevin: summary decision: try hotfix -> conditional canary at 10% with hourly eval gates; pin/rollback if gate fails. product approved. action items: ajay (hotfix), sophie (manual spot checks), luis (alerting), olivia (prod sign-off).

deploybot: preflight check-in scheduled in 60m (pf-1765001234-3).

olivia: TY all. :thumbsup:

kevin: closing thread, will update if anything changes.
